atomic_gap_discussion: The initial phrase 'inherited P1-P3 code' was representation-incomplete on new complement cells. The cell rejected silent inheritance and repaired the proof via an independently coded new block plus C044 multiplexing.
Row-projection disjointness is load-bearing. Column disjointness is automatic for the fresh half, so the next genuine coupling search should target first repeated active prefix row.
A row collision would only defeat block separability; it would not by itself imply rho growth because a different global cover may still exist.
The G17 upper result is local mathematical closure. The lack of a uniform recurrence/circuit bridge is a separate gluing failure, not a defect in the finite proof.
